newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 95,000 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 95,000 -USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts Friday were 95,000 head, compared with 103,000 a week ago and 85,000 a year ago. Saturday's estimate was 15,000 head, compared with 17,000 a week ago and 8,000 a year ago. Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts steady to $0.50 per cwt lower than the midsession Thursday.
Trade slow for light to moderate demand and offerings.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts 1.00-1.50 higher. Sows uneven, generally steady. Receipts this week 506,000 last week 532,000, last year 479,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending Jun 14, 1997 254.3 lbs compared to 256.1 lbs previous week 249.1 lbs last year.
